column1: #  OBSOLETE - not referenced by the build. The live table is
#  partitions_8mb_ota.csv; the board has 8 MB of flash
#  Partition table for the WT32-ETH01 with 2 MB flash
#  designed for 4 MB+ and do not fit into 2 MB. This table is cut by hand to
#    otadata   8 KB   - remembers which app slot is active
#  App partitions must start on 64 KB boundaries (MMU mmap requirement) -
#  hence the gap between the end of otadata (0x11000) and the start of app0
#  (0x20000). The result uses the 2 MB down to the last byte.
